_provenance: opt-local-stt-vram benchmark configuration, created 2026-09-26 from the voice-panel model comparison of that day. Every value is a {value, provenance} pair (R4); a missing key is an explicit error (R3).

default_candidates.provenance: chosen 2026-09-26 - the four faster-whisper variants measured that day beside the resident writer-role model; the operator passes --model to test others

default_engine.provenance: chosen 2026-09-26 - the engine rt-observe's voice panel runs (observe-config.json voice.stt.engine)

device.provenance: chosen by the operator 2026-09-26 ('no CPU, all on GPU'), the voice panel's own device

language.provenance: chosen 2026-09-26 - the voice panel's dropdown default; --language fr|en fixes it, which is what a reference in one language should use

runs_per_file.provenance: chosen 2026-09-26 - the median of 5 was stable to 0.05 s on the 19.5 s recording across two full reruns that day

other_process_warn_mib.provenance: measured 2026-09-26 - desktop and browser processes held 4-27 MiB of dedicated VRAM, a second Whisper left open in the dashboard held 595-929 MiB; 100 MiB separates the noise from a process that changes the measurement

live_budget_ms.provenance: equals rt-observe observe-config.json voice.partial_refresh_ms (asserted by test_engines_config.py): a candidate that transcribes the longest recording within one live refresh keeps the caption live

max_llm_demoted_pct.provenance: chosen 2026-09-26 in the session, accepted by the operator with the scored table: small 2%, turbo 7%, medium 8% passed; large-v3 at 24% demoted 1.3 GB of the LLM, the 5.3 -> 4 GB drop the operator saw

accuracy.provenance: chosen by the operator 2026-09-26 ('the main issue is the speed and error'), equal weight

speed.provenance: chosen by the operator 2026-09-26, equal weight with accuracy

vad_filter.provenance: equals rt-observe voice.stt.vad_filter (asserted by test): the benchmark measures what the panel runs

role.provenance: the vault daemon answers voice questions with the writer-role model, so that is the model resident beside Whisper

process_names.provenance: measured 2026-09-26 - Ollama 0.33.0 on Windows runs the model in a child named llama-server.exe, which holds the VRAM

probe_prompt.value: In two sentences, explain what a git worktree is.
probe_prompt.provenance: chosen 2026-09-26 - a short fixed prompt whose answer time after a transcription shows what paging the LLM back costs

probe_tokens.provenance: chosen 2026-09-26 - long enough for a stable decode rate (median 28.4 tok/s over 60 tokens that day), short enough to keep a probe under 3 s

child.provenance: measured 2026-09-26 - large-v3 (about 3 GB) took 736 s to download at about 4 MB/s; one hour bounds a slower link without hanging forever (R10)

llm_call.provenance: chosen 2026-09-26 - covers an LLM reload from disk after eviction, measured under 10 s on this machine

gpu_counter.provenance: chosen 2026-09-26 - Get-Counter answered in 1-3 s that day; 60 s bounds a stalled PowerShell

install.provenance: the voice panel's own pinned, pip-audited requirement files

module.provenance: declared 2026-09-26 at the operator's request, for a machine whose GPU can hold NVIDIA models such as Canary-Qwen 2.5B beside the LLM; not implemented yet

install.value: not available yet - the adapter must be implemented first (see SKILL.md, Known limitations)
